# Noise corpus (synthetic)
#
# Posts the scorer must reject. Real-world chatter that looks adjacent to a job
# post but isn't. `test_failure_corpus_is_rejected` requires ZERO of these to
# pass - a regression here is what lets job-seeker posts and spam into the queue.
#
# All synthetic: fictional handles and text.
#
# Categories covered: job seekers, engagement bait, crypto/NFT spam, market and
# funding news, hackathon recaps, memes, product promos, paid/unpaid internship
# scams, government-job spam, giveaways and quiz bait.
